author: John Hammond
description:
A fake Microsoft security module? Not quite.

This phishing page tries to convince users they need to install a "Microsoft security module" before they can continue. The download is actually a batch script named Microsoft.bat, a simple but effective social engineering trick.

Watch the full investigation to see how this campaign works from the Google ad all the way through the malware analysis.

Full video: https://youtu.be/NIi4i9IjshM?si=xBA1adt1tjFJfnIH
title: Fake Microsoft Installer
